prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding new screens (new_screen) was helpful, winning 5 tests (up to +15.4%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 5 showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen info updates (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (up to +5.7%), though 1 hurt performance (-6.0%) and 7 showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) were helpful, winning 2 tests (+7.0% and +8.7%), though 2 hurt performance (-3.7% and -3.8%) and 3 showed no clear effect.
Redesigns (redesign) were helpful, winning 1 test (+9.0%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.5%) and 5 showed no clear effect.
Step reordering (reorder) hurt performance in 1 test (-3.8%) and showed no clear effect in 2 tests, while copy changes, hints, notifications, and new flows showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins (e.g., predicting -2.0% vs +8.7% measured, -1.5% vs +9.0% measured) and overestimated changes that hurt performance or had no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Desktop Pet Interaction Mode Selection Screen: Add a new screen during adoption allowing users to set their pet's default desktop behavior (e.g. Quiet Observer, Active Companion, Playful Explorer). (why: Adoption completion takes a long median of 89s and mean of 1017s, and users express confusion later about how the pet behaves on desktop.)
1: [home, wait_info] Background Engine Performance Tip on Waiting: Display background resource usage and auto-pause behavior information during generation waiting time. (why: 3 support emails reported application stalling or desktop rendering issues upon setup.)
2: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Permanent Account Guarantee Copy: Update adoption certificate copy to explicitly state that the pet companion is permanently linked to the signed-in account. (why: Reduces anxiety around account reset issues which generated 8 support emails last week.)
3: [finish, notification] First Desktop Summon Tray Notification: Enable desktop readiness notification and update hint text on home intro to guide users to system tray options. (why: The finish step mean duration is 5815s and overall onboarding completion is low (37.4%), indicating users lose track of the app.)

scores.note: Adding a new screen during adoption targets long step duration and has a strong historical track record (+2.5% avg, up to +15.4% wins), but requires building a new screen.
